batchRequest.request: Add a weather strip at the top and make the lead story's image larger.

patchOf:
root = Stack([masthead, sep, lead, secHeader, secCards, mostHeader, mostList])
masthead = CardHeader("Riverton Daily", "Local news for Riverton and the surrounding valley")
sep = Separator()
lead = Card([leadImg, leadTag, leadTitle, leadBody, leadBtns])
leadImg = Image("Crowd gathered at the Riverton waterfront for the annual lantern festival")
leadTag = TagBlock(["Community", "Top Story"], "sm")
leadTitle = TextContent("Waterfront Lantern Festival Draws Record Crowd of 12,000", "large-heavy")
leadBody = TextContent("Thousands filled the Riverton waterfront on Saturday evening as the city's annual lantern festival returned with expanded food stalls, live music and a new floating lantern display. Organizers say attendance is up 30% from last year, and local businesses report their busiest weekend of the season.")
leadBtns = Buttons([Button("Read full story", @ToAssistant("Show the full story: Waterfront Lantern Festival Draws Record Crowd"), "primary"), Button("Photo gallery", @ToAssistant("Show photo gallery of the lantern festival"), "secondary")])
secHeader = InlineHeader("More Headlines", "Latest from around town")
secCards = ContextCardBlock([c1, c2, c3], "grid")
c1 = ContextCardItem("h1", t1, "City council approves $4.2M plan to repave Main Street and add protected bike lanes.", "gray")
t1 = Tag("Politics", null, "sm", "info")
c2 = ContextCardItem("h2", t2, "Riverton High's girls soccer team advances to the state semifinals after 2-1 win.", "gray")
t2 = Tag("Sports", null, "sm", "success")
c3 = ContextCardItem("h3", t3, "New bakery on Elm Street draws lines with its cardamom morning buns.", "gray")
t3 = Tag("Food", null, "sm", "warning")
mostHeader = InlineHeader("Most Read", "Trending stories today")
mostList = ListBlock([m1, m2, m3, m4, m5], "number")
m1 = ListItem("Lantern festival draws record crowd", "Community · 6 min read", null, "Read", @ToAssistant("Open story: Lantern festival draws record crowd"))
m2 = ListItem("Main Street repaving plan approved", "Politics · 4 min read", null, "Read", @ToAssistant("Open story: Main Street repaving plan approved"))
m3 = ListItem("Where to find the best fall hikes nearby", "Outdoors · 5 min read", null, "Read", @ToAssistant("Open story: best fall hikes nearby"))
m4 = ListItem("School board debates later start times", "Education · 7 min read", null, "Read", @ToAssistant("Open story: school board start times"))
m5 = ListItem("Elm Street bakery's buns sell out by 9am", "Food · 3 min read", null, "Read", @ToAssistant("Open story: Elm Street bakery"))
request: Add a weather strip at the top and make the lead story's image larger.
